note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God is never pictured; the human and the woman are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today; nothing violent and no nakedness is shown (verse 25's nakedness without shame is shown through two lives grown into one).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

sections.meaning: Everything God made is finished, and he ceases from all his work on the seventh day, blessing that day and setting it apart.
ideas: A painter's studio in still morning light: a finished painting of a whole world (sky, sea, land, trees, birds) on the easel, the brush laid down, the stool empty
A carpenter's workshop at rest: a finished handmade cabinet in the middle of the swept floor, every tool hung back in its place
Work boots set side by side on a doorstep at evening, a fully planted garden beyond
A farmer resting on a bench at the edge of his fully sown field, his tools leaned against the fence
A vast starry sky over a still lake: the heavens and all their array complete
A newly built house with its garden planted, the scaffolding gone, a ladder folded against the wall
A quiet street on a day of rest: shop shutters down, a family walking slowly together
A hammock hanging still between two trees in a finished garden
A completed jigsaw-like stone wall with the last stone set and the mason's trowel laid on top
A family sitting together on a blanket under a tree on a slow, quiet day, nothing to do

sections.meaning: Before anything grew there was no rain and no one to work the ground, only water rising from the earth; then God shaped the human from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into him, and he became a living being.
ideas: Bare dry brown earth with not one plant on it, and a spring welling up in the middle, spreading shining water across the soil
A wide empty valley floor seen from a little above, water from a spring spreading in a shining sheet across the bare ground
Mist rising at dawn off a wide field of bare dark earth where nothing grows yet
An old plough lying unused at the edge of a bare unplanted field
A newborn baby held up in gentle hands, mouth open in its very first breath
A young man lying on bare dusty earth, his eyes just opening and his chest rising with a first deep breath
A potter's hands shaping wet clay on a wheel
Cupped hands holding a heap of dark soil with a tiny green shoot breaking out of it
A swimmer bursting up from under water, taking a great breath
A man's breath clouding in cold morning air as he breathes out

sections.meaning: God planted a garden of delight and put the human in it, full of trees lovely to look at and good to eat, with the tree of life and the tree of knowing good and bad in the middle.
ideas: A lush garden of fruit trees heavy with ripe fruit, flowers and a stream, one great old tree standing in the very middle
A man seen from behind stepping through an open gate into an overflowing orchard, a great tree in the middle
Hands planting a young sapling in rich soil
A child running wide-eyed into a blossoming orchard
Two great trees standing side by side in the middle of a flowering garden
A table under a fruit tree laid with fruit just picked from it
A greenhouse bursting with every kind of fruit and flower
An apple orchard in blossom seen from a hilltop
Close view of branches bent low under ripe pomegranates, figs and oranges
A gardener at dawn among rows of young fruit trees he has planted

sections.meaning: One river flows out of the garden and divides into four, carrying its water out to the whole world and to lands rich with good gold and precious stones.
ideas: From high above, one broad river leaves a green garden-land and splits into four rivers spreading out across a vast landscape
In a garden, water from one spring runs into a channel that splits into four channels running out in four directions
Gold nuggets and polished dark and blue stones glinting under clear shallow river water
Wet hands holding a gold pan full of glittering flakes beside a river
A river delta seen from the air, fanning into many branches
A river leaving a lush valley and greening the desert as it flows on
Four streams pouring from one spring in a rock face
A great river winding away to the far horizon through many lands
Irrigation channels carrying one stream's water out to four green fields
A rough onyx stone being turned in a hand, its bands catching the light

sections.meaning: God settles the human in the garden to work it and keep it, gives him every tree freely, and forbids only one, warning that eating from it brings death.
ideas: An open orchard of fruit trees heavy with fruit, and in the middle one single tree with a low rope fence round it
In a strawberry patch, a father's large hand gently holds back a small child's hand reaching for a bush of glossy dark berries
A young gardener walking the rows of an orchard with a watering can and pruning shears
A forager's basket full of good mushrooms, one bright red toadstool left untouched
A gardener at dusk walking the paths of the garden with a lantern, watching over it
A full kitchen table of food, one bottle on a high shelf out of reach
A gate in an orchard standing wide open, every path free
A worker's hands pruning a vine heavy with grapes
A man picking fruit from every tree, passing one by
A park lawn open to everyone, with one small flower bed roped off

sections.meaning: It is not good for the human to be alone; he names every animal God brings to him, but among them all there is no partner who matches him.
ideas: A man eating alone at the end of a long table, every other chair empty
A man alone on a two-seat bench in a wide green park, the place beside him empty
A young man kneeling in a meadow with his hand held out as deer, horse, dog, fox, rabbits and birds gather to meet him
On a farmhouse porch at dusk a man sits in one of two rocking chairs, the other empty, every kind of animal around him
A man naming a new puppy as it licks his face
A zookeeper among many animals at feeding time
A single swan on a lake
A man looking at his reflection in a window at night
A man walking a dog along an empty beach
One lit window in a dark apartment block

sections.meaning: God brings a deep sleep on the man, makes a woman from his own side and brings her to him, and he greets her with joy as truly his own: bone from his bones, flesh from his flesh.
ideas: A man fast asleep in a hammock in a shady garden
A man asleep on his side on a blanket under a great tree
A bride walks up a garden aisle on her father's arm (both from behind) toward the groom, whose face breaks with joy
A groom turns to see his bride for the first time and his face fills with joyful wonder
A man and a woman standing side by side, her head on his shoulder
Two hands, a man's and a woman's, pressed palm to palm, the same shape
A man running to embrace a woman at an airport arrivals gate
A man in a garden lifting his face in delight at a woman walking toward him

A father placing his daughter's hand in the groom's hand

sections.meaning: A man leaves his father and mother and holds fast to his wife, the two become one flesh, and they stand together with nothing hidden and no shame.
ideas: Two trees that grew side by side in a meadow, joined into one single trunk
A young married couple walking barefoot hand in hand across a meadow, at ease and laughing, his parents waving far behind
Two hands with wedding rings clasped with fingers woven together
Newlyweds driving away while parents wave from the porch
An old couple walking hand in hand, leaning into each other
A young couple carrying boxes into their first home
Two streams meeting and running on as one river

Two vines grown round one another up a post
Two candles lit into one flame

candidates.prompt: A quiet painter's studio in clear, soft morning light from a tall window. On a wooden easel stands a large finished painting of a whole world: a wide blue sky, the sea, green hills and trees, birds in the air, every part of the canvas complete. The brush has been laid down across a clean palette on a small table beside the easel, and the stool in front of it is empty. Everything is still; the work is done.

A carpenter's workshop at rest in calm, clear morning light. In the middle of the swept wooden floor stands a beautiful finished handmade wooden cabinet, smooth and complete. Every tool hangs back in its place on the wall above the tidy workbench, and a folded work apron lies on the bench. Nothing is being worked on; everything is finished and still.

A wide stretch of bare, dry brown earth with not a single plant, shrub or blade of grass on it, under a pale clear sky. In the middle of it, clear water is welling up out of the ground in a small spring and spreading outward in shining rivulets across the dry soil, darkening the earth as it goes.

Seen from a little above, a wide empty valley floor of bare earth where nothing at all grows yet: no grass, no shrubs, no trees, no paths, no fences. From a spring in the middle of it, water is spreading out in a thin shining sheet across the ground. Soft overcast early light, distant bare hills.

In a softly lit room, a newborn baby only moments old, loosely wrapped in a white cloth, is held up in a pair of gentle adult hands (only the hands and forearms are seen). The baby's mouth is open in its very first breath and cry, its tiny fists raised, its whole small body alive. Clean, warm, bright light.

Seen from above at a slight angle, a young man in a plain grey t-shirt and work trousers lies on his back on bare, dusty brown earth, a fine layer of dust on his arms and clothes. His eyes have just opened and his chest is lifting with a first deep breath, lips parted, face turned up toward a clear morning sky.

A lush garden full of fruit trees heavy with ripe fruit: oranges, pomegranates, figs and apples, every tree beautiful and green, flowers along soft grassy paths and a small clear stream running through. In the very middle of the garden stands one great, broad, ancient tree, taller than all the others. Fresh, bright morning light.

A man in plain everyday clothes, seen from behind, stands just inside an open wooden garden gate, looking into a vast overflowing orchard: rows of fruit trees heavy with ripe fruit of every colour, flowers in the grass, and in the middle of it all one great tall tree rising above the rest. Bright, fresh morning light.

Seen from high above, a single broad shining river flows out of a lush green garden-land and then splits into four separate rivers that spread out in four different directions across a vast landscape of plains and hills toward far horizons. Clear midday light, the water gleaming.

In a green garden, clear water bubbles up from a single spring into a simple stone basin and flows out of it into four straight stone channels that run away in four different directions across the lawn, each channel lined with fruit trees. Clear bright daylight. No buildings, no statues.

A close view of a clear, shallow, sunlit river running over a bed of pebbles, where nuggets of bright gold and polished dark banded onyx and deep blue stones glint under the moving water. Ripples of light across the riverbed.

A pair of wet hands holds a round metal gold pan just above a clear river; in it, among a little water, lie glittering flakes and nuggets of gold and a few polished coloured stones. Behind, out of focus, the river flows on through a wide green land. Bright daylight.

An open orchard of fruit trees heavy with ripe fruit of many kinds stretches out in every direction, the grass between them green and inviting, every tree free to walk up to. In the very middle stands one single tree with a simple low rope fence around it, the only tree that is fenced off. Clear bright daylight.

In a sunny garden full of ripe red strawberries, a father's large hand gently holds back a small child's hand that is reaching toward a single plant of glossy black berries that must not be eaten. Only the hands and forearms are seen, close up. Warm, calm, bright light.

In a quiet house in the evening, a man sits alone at the end of a long wooden dining table, eating by himself. Every other chair along the table is empty. Warm lamplight, the rest of the room dim and still.

A man sits alone on a park bench in a wide, beautiful green park on a bright afternoon, looking quietly into the distance. The bench is made for two and the place beside him is empty. No one else is near.

A young man in plain clothes kneels in a wide sunny meadow at the edge of a wood, one hand held out, as many animals come up to meet him: a deer, a horse, a dog, a fox, rabbits and sheep, with birds landing on the grass and on a branch above him. He looks at them with interest, as if finding a name for each.

On the porch of a lone farmhouse in the soft light of early evening, a man sits in one of two rocking chairs; the chair beside him is empty. His dog lies at his feet, a cat sits on the railing, his horse leans its head over the fence, sheep and chickens wander the yard and birds line the roof. He has every kind of animal around him but no one beside him.

A man lies in a hammock strung between two trees in a shady green garden, fast asleep in a deep, peaceful sleep, one arm resting across his chest, his face calm. Soft dappled light through the leaves.

A man lies on his side on a plain blanket in the grass beneath a great shady tree, sound asleep in a deep, peaceful sleep, his head on his arm and his face relaxed. Quiet, soft afternoon light in a green garden.

At a simple outdoor wedding in a garden, a bride in a plain white dress walks up a grassy aisle on her father's arm, both seen from behind, toward the groom waiting at the far end. The groom faces us: his hands have risen to his mouth and his eyes shine with tears of joy as he sees her coming. The guests are only a soft blur at the edges. Bright, clear daylight, no arch and no symbols.

In a green garden, a young groom in a plain suit has just turned around to see his bride for the first time. She stands close in front of him, seen from behind in a simple white dress, and his face breaks into overwhelmed, joyful wonder, his eyes wet and his hands rising. Bright daylight.

In an open green meadow, two trees that grew up side by side have joined together into one single trunk, their two stems woven into one and their branches into one wide crown. Bright clear morning light, green grass all around.

A young married couple in simple light summer clothes walk barefoot hand in hand across a sunlit meadow, leaning into each other and laughing freely, completely at ease with each other. Far behind them, small on a farmhouse porch, his mother and father wave them off.
